metadata_constructor_review.description: During the matrix, precursor_in_ms2 was corrected to typed integer 0/1 and fragment_mass_tolerance_ppm to string projection 0/1 after tracing C++ DataValue constructor selection. Both compiler all-feature annotation suites were rerun against the correction; optional-feature matrix, lint, documentation and example checks completed after it.

coverage.strategy: Complete all-feature/all-target 993-test suite on Rust 1.96; focused all-feature RNA and unit tests on Rust 1.85; focused no-default-feature RNA and unit tests on both compilers. Complete pre-increment 938-test runs on both compilers retained as historical evidence.

rna_dependency_test_adjustment.description: The optional serde_json dependency added cross-type PartialEq implementations, making two old assert_eq!(integer_slice, []) statements ambiguous. They now use equivalent is_empty() assertions. No scientific expected values changed.

rna_reference_literal_lint.description: Added a narrowly scoped Clippy excessive_precision allowance to the independently sourced carbon-13 mass literal13.003355000000001. Literal value and all scientific expectations retained; all three RNA workflows rerun on both compilers after this test-only annotation.

rna_processing_shared_formula_budget.description: The private sequence formula helper now accepts shared counters for spectrum precursor generation while preserving public formula/mass arithmetic and order. Four sequence-private tests and one spectrum-private regression verify cumulative work/allocation, failure counters, original mass bits and unchanged inputs. All RNA suites and all unit tests pass on both compilers.
